message: The other day, I found myself in the family group chat, frantically typing reminders about our emergency go-bags. I had a moment of panic when I realized we hadn’t updated them in ages! As I watched family members chime in with what they thought should go in, it turned into a lighthearted brainstorm—who knew my brother would want gummy bears in his bag? 😄 It reminded me that preparedness doesn’t have to be stressful; it can be a team effort filled with laughter. What’s your go-to tip for keeping your family prepared?
